title: You're building something
subtitle: The Well Summit is at a pivotal point — strategic plan complete, Lily Foundation grant in progress, and a 5-year growth roadmap ready to execute. Getting the right infrastructure in place now is what makes the next chapter possible.

items.heading: Strategic clarity, operational gap
items.body: The StratOP process is done. Goals are set. What's missing is the system to run it — donor data is scattered, giving platforms are disconnected, stewardship happens by memory.

items.heading: Funding opportunity in front of you
items.body: The Lily Foundation grant requires naming a technology vendor. Choosing DonorDock now supports the grant narrative and positions The Well Summit for funded capacity-building.

items.heading: Growth that honors your mission
items.body: Scaling access without scaling complexity requires tools that work harder in the background, so your team stays focused on people and ministry.

what_you_need.title: What you need from a platform
items: One place for every donor, supporter, and camper
Giving pages that replace Givebutter and ThriveCart
A pipeline to track grants, major gifts, and sponsors
Email and text connected to your CRM data
Automations that handle follow-up you'd otherwise miss
A migration team that moves your current data for you
A partner, not just a vendor

quote.text: If we run the nonprofit more like a business and instill streamlined efficiencies, we'll have the capacity to offer additional program events to expand access — but still keep it intimate.
quote.attribution: Tiffany Brodie, COO, The Well Summit
